prompts.storage:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual standalone static 2D strategy game building source artwork, not a contact sheet or presentation mockup.
Create ONE botanical STORAGE building for a small peaceful forest creature colony. A broad squat living seed-pod granary, creamy ivory overlapping shell-like petals enclosing three simple warm-gold seed sacks visible through one wide front opening, pale sage leaf awning, two curling root feet, a little bundled timber compartment at one side. It must read immediately as a storage building with a large full belly, not a dwelling or a treasure chest. No human-made metal fittings.
Match this established art language precisely: smooth high-resolution hand-painted botanical fantasy illustration, large simple rounded shapes, softly blended matte ivory and pale sage surfaces, restrained warm honey-gold accents, fine continuous deep-green-teal contour lines, soft warm upper-left illumination. Charming elegant calm mobile/PC strategy-game asset. A slightly elevated frontal three-quarter view with modest visible roof, same compact scale as a small flower nest. NOT pixel art, no blocky/stepped edges, no 3D-render plastic, no gritty texture or fine clutter.
One complete object centered with a clear full silhouette, square canvas, object occupies about 80 percent of canvas, generous clear margin, genuinely transparent RGBA background. No ground disc, floor, external shadow, scenery, characters, faces, eyes, text, labels, frame, watermark. This is the actual new source sprite candidate.

Subject: a botanical EVOLUTION LAB, visibly distinct from a storage hut. A vertically elongated ivory seed-pod chamber split open at its front, holding one large softly glowing honey-gold translucent seed suspended inside a simple spiral of pale-sage leaves. A few clean blue-green dew droplets touch the inner seed shell, no machinery or human furniture. Silhouette tall and compact, a warm living chrysalis where seeds grow stronger.
